answer: An agent economy can price admission with per-identity cognition: before a key may act, it must solve a fresh puzzle seeded from the epoch's kernel - a small proof-of-thought no template can precompute - under a cedar-shaded canopy of witnesses who sample and re-run solutions, and any farm that mints N clones owes N such computations, so a reef of cheap fake agents becomes a compute bill that grows exactly as fast as the attack: sybil resistance as a metered tax, not a template.
